segments.text: In fact, the one who has become just like Shiva, not Shiva, because Shiva will become just after living his physical frame.
Nitya Mevam Vrata Japa Charya Anishtata, who is situated always functioning the internal recitation of Ajapa and his daily routine of life.
And this way, who is Niji Shakti Chakra Ruda, who governs, who rules his own wheel of energies.
That person only can be helpful to others in eliminating them.
He says that explains that in this sutra.
Yo, that master, who is Ayapasta, who has established the sovereignty on Shakti Chakra, on the wheel of energies.
The wheel of energies are classified in two ways. One is classified in energies pertaining to cognition. The other wheel is pertaining to action.
Janindrayas and Karmindrayas, these energies do not play him. He plays on those energies. He becomes player. He is not played by these energies.
Just as we are, we are played by these energies. Whatever our energies of sensual energies ask, demand, we are bound to obey them.
But he is not like that. He governs on them. That master who governs on this Shakti Chakra, Jaha Tushka, he becomes the purpose of inserting real knowledge in others.
He becomes the cause of inserting knowledge in others, God consciousness in others, no one else.
This is the meaning of the sutra. Yo, Ayapasta, Jaha Tushka, the one who is Ayapa means Shakti Chakra.
Star means who is established on Shakti Chakra, who governs Shakti Chakra, who is not played by Shakti Chakra.
He becomes Jaha Tushka, so Jaha Tushka, he becomes the cause of inserting knowledge in others, real knowledge, pure knowledge.
Now commentary. Aviyan, Pashun, Pati, Ayapam. Aviyan means Pashun. Those who are ignorant people, ignorant people are protected in their own way by Shakti Chakras.
These Shakti Chakras protect these ignorant souls by providing them with taste, with roof, with formation, with touch, with smell,
with all whatever they need. This is protect protection, not in real way protection. They protect them in providing them these things, these pleasures of sensual pleasures.
And those Shaktis, those energies are kavagadishu, Mahesharyadeya, Pashmata, Yadya, Abhid, Dresha. In this sutra they are explained that these are the mothers of those ignorant people.
And those are called Mahesharyade Shakti Chakra, Maheshary, Khachary, Gochary, Dictory, Bhuchary etc. All these, those who are concerned with sensual pleasures,
sensual organic field. For instance, Janindryas and Karmendryas. Tatra, Tishtati. That master, who is established on them,
the establishment means, with it, Samahat, Mehta, Prabhattin or Pratapati. It does not become the play. It's their play.
On the contrary, he plays on them. He is player. Sir Gya Hetu, he becomes the cause of inserting knowledge to others.
Janati Yad Gya, Gya means the knowledge, Jhane Shakti. Tisya Hetu, he becomes the source of that knowledge. For whom, Upadeshaan, those who are Upadesha, Upadesha means disciples.
Jhane Shakti Yad Gya, by the energy of knowledge, Pratapati Yatum, Shama, he becomes successful in inserting knowledge in his disciples.
Anyastu, Shakti Chakra Parthantry Krta Tat, the one who has come under the influence, in the influence of these waves of energies,
under the influence of these senses, who is dependent on senses.
Swarthmani approvation, who is, he cannot do anything for himself. He cannot protect himself. Katham Ainyan Prabhadev, how can he protect others, his disciples?
He is himself bound in following the demand of his senses. How can he elevate others? It is impossible.
Yatshabda, pekiya, sutre, atra, tatshabda and diahariya. In this sutra, there is yatshabda. Yatshabda means yo.
From yatshabda, yo has been produced. Tatshabda must be added to this sutra. Because, as long as there is yatshabda,
then you should put yaya ayupasta, say yaya hetu, you must put sir also, tatshabda.
Yo, I am ayupasta, the one who is established, who governs this wheel of energies. Sir, that person, that master,
as Yatshabda, as Jan Prabodhan Hetu, he becomes the cause of inserting knowledge in others.
So, it is well said. Tatshabda, yuktam uhtam, it is well said, danam atmigan. He is only bestowing thing is atmigan.
He gives atmigan to others, knowledge of self.
Some commentators, comment this sutra in other way, aksarasaro pyaat Prabhurya.
You must explain sutras according to the words. And, this way they explain this sutra.
Yoyati yogindra, yoy means yogindra. Because, yoy is, yoy sounds in yogindra also, yoy, yogindra.
The who is chief yogi, yogiraj, viyeti viganam, viy means vigan, knowledge, per means state,
sir means who is established in that state, yetasi antamaksharam, this is its last word.
Yoyati ghatta, yoy means who knows that.
Heyati heyya, hey means heyya, what is to be abundant.
You means tuchhata, that which is abundant, that is differentiated perception.
And, there is visarga also, visarjaniyana, visarge shakti.
Chakarina, chah, yetu chah, chah is there, anukta, samacya arthena, karta paramasthi.
By chah you must see the one who does this.
So, this meaning comes out of this sutra now.
Yoyoyogindra, that yoyogindra, who emerge shaktia by the energy of his awareness,
sorup atma viganapandastya, he is established in his own nature of God consciousness.
He becomes knower and doer.
Tadaj, I see heyatam, tuchhataam, nissaaratam.
Then he can perceive, differentiate what is to be achieved and what is to be thrown away.
Natu, upade, tam, asadiyati, diva, chakshati.
He does not own that which is to be discarded.
But this kind of meaning, this kind of meaning, no, not pradivati, does not get digestion in our knowledge.
This kind of meaning, we don't recognize.
What was the use of putting this in words then, if he didn't recognize this kind of meaning?
Here, from my point of view, Kamaraja has not done what he ought to have done.
This kind of meaning should have not been put here at all.
Yes, if it was not right.
Because Padārṭhsangatīr nāti ca-rottāt, this kind of meaning is not good.
Why did he put it in commentary?
Pratisutraṁ ce yidrishvaya chakrama ce saha-srasho dārśtum shi-ketāt.
And this kind of explanation can be put in every sutra then.
So this is not good meaning.
Good meaning is the first one.
